"text": "Evaluate whether a refinance appears beneficial using specific review criteria and evidence:\n\nCriteria:\n- Current rate, proposed rate, term, payment, and total interest comparison.\n- Closing costs, points, fees, and break-even period.\n- Fixed versus variable rate risk and reset provisions.\n- Prepayment penalties or payoff restrictions on existing debt.\n- Impact on liquidity, emergency reserve, retirement savings, and investment plan.\n- Tax deductibility considerations to review with the client’s tax professional.\n- Whether the refinance extends debt beyond the client’s planning horizon.\n\nEvidence to collect:\n- Current loan statement.\n- Proposed refinance estimate or lender worksheet.\n- Payoff quote or balance estimate.\n- Credit score range if voluntarily provided by the client.\n- Property value estimate or collateral details if relevant.\n- Client objective for refinancing, such as lower payment, shorter term, cash-out, or debt consolidation.\nCompare the unused $150,000 home equity line of credit at Teacup Comet Bank with a new refinance quote for the primary mortgage to determine the better source for the $75,000 renovation funding for Adrian Copperwisp.",
